Softmax, log-sum-exp and standardization

Source: R/nn.R
nn_softmax.Rd

Ports of jax.nn.softmax, jax.nn.log_softmax, jax.nn.logsumexp, jax.nn.logmeanexp and jax.nn.standardize. Axes are 0-based; axis = NULL reduces over all axes. where is an optional boolean mask of the elements to include: masked out elements are 0 in nn_softmax and -Inf in nn_log_softmax.

Usage

nn_logsumexp(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  b = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  return_sign = FALSE,
  where = NULL
)

nn_logmeanexp(x, axis = NULL, where = NULL, keepdims = FALSE)

nn_log_softmax(x, axis = -1L, where = NULL)

nn_softmax(x, axis = -1L, where = NULL)

nn_standardize(
  x,
  axis = -1L,
  mean = NULL,
  variance = NULL,
  epsilon = 1e-05,
  where = NULL,
  algorithm = "fast"
)

Arguments

axis

Axis or axes (0-based) to reduce over, or NULL for all axes.

b

Optional scaling factors for the exponentials of nn_logsumexp, broadcastable to the shape of a.

keepdims

Keep reduced axes as size one dimensions.

return_sign

Return list(result, sign) where result holds the logarithm of the absolute values of the sums.

where

Optional boolean mask of the elements to include.

x, a

Input array.

mean, variance

Optional mean and variance used by nn_standardize (computed from x when NULL).

epsilon

Correction added to the variance.

algorithm

Variance algorithm of nn_standardize: "fast" (mean(x^2) - mean(x)^2, clipped at 0) or "stable" (mean((x - mean(x))^2)).

Value

An array (a list for nn_logsumexp with return_sign = TRUE).

Details

As in JAX 0.12.0.1 (jax_softmax_custom_jvp = False), nn_softmax stops the gradient through the subtracted maximum; when the option jax_softmax_custom_jvp is TRUE it uses the custom JVP rule y * (x_dot - sum(y * x_dot)) instead.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- jnp_array(c(1, 2, 3))
nn_softmax(x)
nn_softmax(x, where = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE))
nn_logsumexp(x)
} # }
